matches.preview: Manchester United arrive as strong favourites at 70%, with Hull offered only an 11% chance of victory. Last season's form tells the story: Manchester United ended with five consecutive wins including a dominant 3-0 away victory, whilst Hull managed just one win, three draws and two defeats across their final matches. The head-to-head record reinforces this gap; Manchester United have won three of their five recent meetings with Hull and lost none. The model suggests over 2.5 goals at 59%.
matches.preview_zh: Manchester United以強力看好球隊的身份出現，贏球機率為70%，Hull則僅有11%的贏球機率。上賽季的表現充分說明了這個差距：Manchester United在最後階段取得五連勝，包括一場客場3:0的壓倒性勝利，而Hull在最後的比賽中僅取得一勝、三平、兩負。交手紀錄強化了這個差距；Manchester United在最近五次與Hull的交手中贏了三場，未曾敗北。模型預測超過2.5球的機率為59%。

matches.preview: Everton edge the model's assessment at 43%, though the margin is modest against a competitive Palace side. Returning from last season, both clubs showed inconsistent form through their closing matches, with Everton recording two draws amongst four defeats, whilst Palace drew twice in six outings. Their most recent meeting ended 2-2, illustrating their tendency towards tight contests. The head-to-head record favours Everton over the past two years. A low-scoring contest edges slightly ahead in the model's projection, with under 2.5 goals favoured at 52%.
matches.preview_zh: Everton 在模型評估中領先 43%，但面對具競爭力的 Palace 時，優勢並不明顯。延續上個賽季的狀況，兩隊在收官比賽中都表現不穩定，Everton 四場敗績中有兩場平手，Palace 則在六場比賽中有兩場平手。他們最近一次交手以 2-2 結束，說明他們傾向於僅差分毫的比賽。過去兩年的交戰紀錄對 Everton 有利。低得分比賽在模型預測中略佔上風，少於 2.5 球的概率為 52%。

matches.preview: The model backs Ipswich by the slimmest margin at 36%, with Sunderland at 35% and a draw at 29%, making this a finely balanced opener. Ipswich showed mixed form in the Championship before returning to the Premier League; Sunderland's recent Premier League campaign included impressive victories over Chelsea and Everton but a heavy loss to Nott'm Forest. Head-to-head strongly favours Ipswich, who have won all four recent meetings. The model leans under 2.5 goals at 53%, suggesting a cautious affair.
matches.preview_zh: 模型對Ipswich的支持度以最微弱的優勢達36%，Sunderland為35%，平手為29%，使得本場揭幕戰局勢極為接近。Ipswich在重返英超前於英冠聯賽中表現參差不齊；Sunderland近期英超賽事中戰勝Chelsea和Everton表現亮眼，但慘敗給Nottm Forest。對陣紀錄明顯傾向Ipswich，該隊在近期四場交手中全部勝出。模型預測傾向少於2.5球，達53%，暗示本場比賽將趨於保守。

matches.preview: Nottingham Forest are slight favourites at 41%, with Leeds at 31% and the draw at 28% suggesting a competitive encounter. Both clubs finished last season with identical records of three wins from six matches, though Forest's victories came with greater flourish, including a 5-0 away success, while Leeds ended with a heavy away defeat. Their recent head-to-head meetings have seen the sides alternate 3-1 victories, both matches producing multiple goals. The probability model leans slightly towards under 2.5 goals at 51%.
matches.preview_zh: Nottingham Forest被看好的概率為41%，Leeds為31%，平局為28%，表明這將是一場競爭激烈的對賽。兩隊上個賽季的戰績完全相同，各在六場比賽中取勝三場，但Nottingham Forest的勝利更加出色，包括一場5:0的客場大勝，而Leeds則以一場沉重的客場敗績結束賽季。近期交手中，兩隊各自取得過3:1的勝利，兩場比賽的進球都較多。概率模型略微傾向於少於2.5球的結果，概率為51%。

matches.preview: Brentford are slight favourites at 41%, though Tottenham at 33% make this finely balanced, with draws at 26%. Spurs hold significant historical advantage in this fixture, winning three of the last five meetings, with their most recent encounter ending goalless. Brentford's closing season showed volatility, highlighted by a 3-0 home win yet followed by a 0-3 away loss. Tottenham proved more consistent, recording three victories across their final matches including away wins at Wolves and Aston Villa. The model rates over 2.5 goals at 57%.
matches.preview_zh: Brentford以41%略佔上風，Tottenham則為33%，平手占26%，整體勢均力敵。Spurs在此對陣中握有顯著的歷史優勢，近五次交手中贏得三場，最近的一次交手以0:0結束。Brentford本賽季末段表現波動，一場3:0的主場勝利隨之出現0:3的客場落敗。Tottenham表現則更為穩健，最後幾場賽事中取得三場勝利，包括作客Wolves和Aston Villa的兩場勝利。模型評估進球數超過2.5的概率為57%。

matches.preview: Brighton edges the model forecast at 44%, but Aston Villa's 30% probability combined with the 27% draw possibility makes this a finely balanced contest. Head-to-head history favours Villa notably, who have won three of their last five meetings, including a 3-0 victory at this ground. Brighton's form from the end of last season proved mixed, with three defeats among their final six league matches. The goal market leans over 2.5 at 55%, reflecting the attacking patterns evident in recent meetings between these clubs.
matches.preview_zh: Brighton 在模型預測中領先 44%，但 Aston Villa 30% 的勝率結合 27% 的平局可能性，使這場對陣勢均力敵。對戰歷史對 Villa 明顯有利，最近五場交手中 Villa 贏得三場，包括在此球場的一次 3-0 勝利。Brighton 上賽季末的表現並不穩定，最後六場聯賽中有三場落敗。進球數超過 2.5 球的預測佔 55%，反映了這兩隊最近交手中的進攻特點。

matches.preview: The model backs Manchester City at 65% to win. Both teams return to this level after last season's close in May. City showed three wins and two draws over six matches but finished with a 1-2 home loss to Villa. Bournemouth won three times but drew three, including 1-1 with City and 2-2 with Leeds, and beat Palace 3-0. Manchester City's recent home record against Bournemouth has been strong: two 3-1 victories. The model forecasts 65% for over 2.5 goals.
matches.preview_zh: 模型估算Manchester City以65%的機率獲勝。兩隊回到去年5月的水準。City在6場比賽中取得3勝2平，但主場以1-2不敵Villa。Bournemouth則取得3勝3平，包括與City的1-1打平及與Leeds的2-2打平，以及3-0擊敗Palace。Manchester City近期在主場對陣Bournemouth的戰績強勢：取得兩場3-1的勝利。模型預測2.5球以上進球的機率為65%。

matches.preview: Liverpool are the model's clear preference at 48%, with Newcastle's win probability limited to 27% and a draw possible at 25%. Liverpool's record in recent head-to-head contests has been striking: they won 4-1 in January and 3-2 the previous August. Both sides displayed inconsistent form toward the end of the spring season, though Newcastle managed only two wins from their final six matches. The model leans decisively toward an entertaining contest, with over 2.5 goals favoured at 63%.
matches.preview_zh: Liverpool是該模型的明確首選，機率為48%，Newcastle的勝率為27%，平局的機率為25%。Liverpool在近期對戰紀錄中表現亮眼：1月贏了4比1，前一年8月則贏了3比2。兩隊在春季賽季末尾表現不穩定，但Newcastle在最後六場比賽中僅獲得兩場勝利。該模型強烈傾向於一場精彩的比賽，進球數超過2.5球的機率為63%。

matches.preview: Chelsea holds a narrow advantage at 48%, though the contest appears finely balanced with Fulham and the draw both at 26%. Returning to this level, Fulham ended the previous season with creditable results against Newcastle and Aston Villa amid variable overall form, while Chelsea managed only a single win across their final six games. Recent head-to-head meetings have proven consistently competitive; Fulham secured a victory in January's home meeting, winning 2-1. The model leans toward over 2.5 goals at 57%.
matches.preview_zh: Chelsea保持小幅領先，佔比48%，不過比賽看起來勢均力敵，Fulham與和局的佔比各為26%。回到這個級別，Fulham在上一賽季末期對Newcastle與Aston Villa取得不錯的成績，整體表現則有起伏，而Chelsea在最後六場比賽中僅獲得一場勝利。近期交手紀錄證明一直競爭激烈；Fulham在1月的主場比賽中以2-1獲勝。模型傾向進球數超過2.5球，概率為57%。

matches.preview: The model favours Bournemouth at 48%, with Everton at 25% and a draw at 27%. Last season's final stretch was inconsistent for Bournemouth, who picked up three wins alongside three draws, while Everton managed just two draws across their final six matches and four losses against Tottenham, Sunderland, West Ham and Liverpool. Bournemouth hold the upper hand in their head-to-head record, winning three of the last five meetings. The match appears finely balanced, with the model expecting over 2.5 goals at 55%.
matches.preview_zh: 該預測模型評估 Bournemouth 勝利的機率為 48%，Everton 為 25%，平局為 27%。上賽季最後階段，Bournemouth 表現不穩定，取得三場勝利和三場平局。Everton 在最後六場比賽中僅有兩場平局，其餘四場對陣 Tottenham、Sunderland、West Ham 和 Liverpool 全數敗北。Bournemouth 在相互交手紀錄中佔據上風，在最近五場交手中取得三場勝利。這場比賽看起來勢均力敵，該模型預期超過2.5球的機率為55%。

matches.preview: The model favours Tottenham at 46%, though Newcastle's 29% and a 25% draw probability suggest a closely competitive encounter. Tottenham's end-of-season form was mixed, with wins over Everton and Aston Villa offset by an away loss to Chelsea and draws with Leeds and Brighton. Newcastle displayed notable home strength but consistent away vulnerability in recent fixtures. The head-to-head record strongly favours Newcastle, who have won four of their last five meetings. Over 2.5 goals is the probability edge at 58%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型看好 Tottenham，支持率為 46%，但 Newcastle 的 29% 與平手的 25% 機率表明這將是勢均力敵的比賽。Tottenham 賽季末期表現起伏，雖贏過 Everton 與 Aston Villa，但也客場輸給 Chelsea，並與 Leeds 及 Brighton 戰平。Newcastle 在近期比賽中展現明顯的主場優勢，但客場表現持續脆弱。交手紀錄明顯偏向 Newcastle，他們在最近五次交手中贏了四場。超過 2.5 進球的機率為 58%。

matches.preview: The model sees this as a closely matched contest. Both Leeds and Brentford are favoured at 36% to win, with the draw at 28%. Recent head-to-head meetings have been tightly contested low-scoring affairs, with their last two encounters in this calendar year finishing 0-0 and 1-1. Looking at the available form from the end of last season, both teams showed mixed results at that stage of the campaign. The model anticipates a higher-scoring game, with over 2.5 goals at 57%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型認為這場比賽勢均力敵。Leeds 與 Brentford 各為 36% 獲勝機率，平手佔 28%。近期交手紀錄為勢均力敵的低比分局面，今年以來兩次交手分別以 0-0 及 1-1 收場。根據上賽季末段的表現，兩隊在當時都呈現混合表現。模型預計這場會是高比分比賽，2.5 球以上的機率為 57%。

matches.preview: The model favours Chelsea at 45%, though with Brighton at 28% and the draw at 27%, this contest is finely balanced. In recent head-to-head meetings, Brighton hold the ascendancy with three wins from the last five, including two emphatic 3-0 victories that illustrate their potency in this fixture. Both teams show inconsistent recent form, with neither establishing clear dominance. The 56% probability of over 2.5 goals suggests an open and attacking match in which both sides pose a threat.
matches.preview_zh: 模型傾向Chelsea為45%，儘管Brighton為28%、平手為27%，這場比賽勢均力敵。在近期對戰中，Brighton佔上風，最近五場中贏了三場，包括兩場3-0的大勝，展現出他們在這場比賽中的實力。兩隊最近的表現都不穩定，均未建立明確的優勢。超過2.5球的機率為56%，顯示這將是一場進攻型比賽，雙方都能構成威脅。

matches.preview: Arsenal are clear favourites at 51%, with Aston Villa at 24% and a draw at 25%. Last season Arsenal were in exceptional form, winning five of their final six matches, while Villa showed mixed results with impressive wins against Manchester City and Liverpool offset by defeats to Fulham and Tottenham. The recent head-to-head between the clubs is finely balanced across their last five meetings. The model leans slightly towards over 2.5 goals at 52%, suggesting this contest should be reasonably competitive despite Arsenal's underlying advantage.
matches.preview_zh: Arsenal以51%明顯領先，Aston Villa為24%，平手為25%。上賽季Arsenal表現出色，最後六場贏得五場，而Villa則成績不穩定，對Manchester City和Liverpool的勝利令人印象深刻，但敗給Fulham和Tottenham。兩隊最近五次對陣的戰績相當均衡。預測模型對超過2.5球稍微傾向，概率為52%，暗示儘管Arsenal具有基礎優勢，這場比賽應該相當具有競爭力。
